purpose: Calibration pilot only. Exact date-complete universe; no canonical repair or live-monitor mutation.

selection_methodology.positive_control_rule: Include every local Kyiv calendar date containing any of the 16 reconciled confirmed strict misses.
selection_methodology.date_completeness_rule: For every selected local Kyiv calendar date, include every frozen Zaporizhzhia alert episode whose active interval overlaps any part of that date. Cross-midnight episodes therefore belong to each selected date they overlap.
selection_methodology.surrounding_date_rule: Starting at ±1 day around each control date, add nearest surrounding dates deterministically (distance first, then date) until the unique episode universe reaches at least 170 without exceeding 200.
selection_methodology.duplicate_episode_handling: Unique by episode_id even when an episode overlaps two selected dates.
